summary.text: Scott DiMauro is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, an open seat with no incumbent.
A former high school social studies teacher, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he served two terms as president of the Ohio Education Association.

paragraphs.text: Scott DiMauro graduated from Walsh Jesuit High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Miami University in 1991 and a graduate degree from Ohio State University in 1996.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Cleveland and raised in Northeast Ohio, spent a career as a high school social studies teacher, and served two terms as president of the Ohio Education Association.
He said he lives in Westlake with his wife, Lauren, a teacher at Bay Middle School in Bay Village, and has two adult daughters.
DiMauro advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
His survey lists fully and fairly funding public schools, protecting essential public services and a fairer tax system among his key messages.
He reported endorsements from organizations including the Ohio AFL-CIO and the Ohio Association of Professional Fire Fighters.
